title: An experimental tour-de-force: Entanglement between glass bead and light
gist: Researchers published in Science the first measurement of entanglement between light fields and an optically levitated, cooled glass bead in an optical cavity. Measurements are noisy and model-dependent, but the system could serve as an engineered quantum memory for quantum communications.
